_comment: Corresponding-source archives attached to every GitHub Release as third-party-sources.<asset>
(THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md section 1; plan steps S12, S14, LIC1). scripts/ci/get-sources.ps1 downloads
each entry, verifies its SHA-256 and checks it against the shipped versions; release.yml attaches
exactly these assets and lists them in the release notes. An entry with 'from_pins' takes url and
sha256 from build/pins.json (the same file the build uses).
Every hash was measured on the date in 'measured' by downloading the file twice (identical both times).
GitHub archive URLs (codeload) are not promised byte-stable: on a mismatch, re-download, check the
tree against the named tag or commit, and re-pin.

archives.name: lxml source distribution
archives.license: BSD-3-Clause (its Windows wheel statically links GNU libiconv, LGPL-2.1-or-later)
archives.measured: 2026-10-18 (equals the sha256 digest published by PyPI)

archives.name: winlibs/libiconv (GNU libiconv 1.17 with the MSVC build files of lxml's Windows wheel), commit
lxml/libxml2-win-binaries build scripts (build.ps1, libiconv.patch), tag
archives.license: no license file upstream; the build recipe of the LGPL-2.1-or-later libiconv above
archives.ships: build recipe of the libiconv, libxml2 2.11.9, libxslt 1.1.45 and zlib 1.3.2 in searxng/lib/lxml/*.pyd
archives.measured: 2026-10-18 (latest release before the lxml 6.1.3 Windows wheels were uploaded on 2026-09-02)
